name: kernux
description: Kernux Agent Operating Environment monorepo root

scripts.check: pnpm check:workspace && pnpm check:protocol && pnpm check:js && pnpm check:rust && pnpm specgrain:check
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check package.json tsconfig.json protocol/fixtures/v1 tools/protocol tools/workspace tools/ui-system tools/specgrain/run.mjs tools/typescript-smoke.ts packages/ui-system/tokens.ts packages/ui-system/primitives.ts apps/desktop/test/design-system.test.ts
scripts.lint: oxlint tools/protocol tools/workspace tools/ui-system tools/specgrain/run.mjs tools/typescript-smoke.ts packages/ui-system/tokens.ts packages/ui-system/primitives.ts apps/desktop/test/design-system.test.ts
scripts.check:js: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:js
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --all-targets
scripts.check:protocol: node tools/protocol/generate.mjs --check && node tools/protocol/conformance.mjs && node tools/protocol/compatibility.mjs && node tools/protocol/adversarial.mjs
